blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Exemplar-free class-incremental learning (EFCIL) requires models to learn new classes sequentially without retaining training samples from previous tasks. Continual concept bottleneck models (CBMs) make their predictions interpretable by identifying visual concepts in an image and using them to score each class. However, these methods typically focus on preserving learned concepts or approximating past classes with generated features, which can leave new concepts underused in old-class predictions. We propose RetroCBM, which retains a small set of vocabulary-independent statistics relating frozen visual features to the embedding space of a pretrained vision-language model. Even after earlier training images have been discarded, we can use these statistics to supervise new concepts. To do so, we develop a retroactive regression rule that yields the same predictor for each new concept as class-balanced ridge regression on all images seen so far. We then reproject the stored statistics to recover the full-history squared classification loss and thus learn how much each new concept should contribute to old-class predictions. Since the classifier may use systematic concept errors to distinguish nearby classes, we further introduce a graph-weighted penalty on the margin shifts caused by those errors. Across six datasets, RetroCBM outperforms state-of-the-art interpretable methods in all class-incremental settings, with an 18.1\% relative gain in mean average incremental accuracy over the strongest exemplar-free baseline.
blocks.zh: Exemplar-无课-增量学习(EFCIL)需要模型依次学习新课而不保留以前任务的培训样本. 连续的概念瓶颈模型通过在图像中识别视觉概念并利用它们来评分每一类,使其预测可以解释. 然而,这些方法通常侧重于保留已学到的概念,或用产生的特征来近似于过去的类,这可能会使新概念在旧类预测中得不到充分利用. 我们建议采用RetroCBM,它保留了一套关于冷冻视觉特征与预先训练的视觉语言模型嵌入空间的词汇独立的统计。 即使在早先的培训图像被丢弃之后,我们仍可以利用这些统计数据监督新的概念。 为此,我们制定了追溯回归规则,在迄今看到的所有图像上,每个新概念的预测器与类平衡脊回归相同。 然后,我们重新预测所储存的统计数据,以恢复整个历史平面的分类损失,从而了解每个新概念应如何有助于旧的预测。 由于分类者可能使用系统的概念错误来区分附近的分类,我们进一步对这些错误造成的差值变化引入了图表加权的处罚. 在所有6个数据集中,RetroCBM在所有类递增设置中都超过了最先进的可解释方法,平均递增精度比最强的无实例基线有18.1+%的相对收益。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
In many visual recognition applications, data of new categories would arrive after the initial model has been trained.
Class-incremental learning (CIL) addresses this setting by training a model on successive groups of classes while requiring it to distinguish among all classes seen to date [ 23 , 11 ] .
The exemplar-free setting (EFCIL) is of particular interest when storage or privacy constraints prevent the model from retaining earlier training images [ 29 , 13 ] .
To keep predictions accurate on earlier classes, existing methods constrain changes to visual representations during fine-tuning [ 27 , 28 ] or update the classifier over a fixed set of features [ 13 , 2 ] .
How the model arrives at those predictions, however, has received less attention [ 16 , 20 , 5 ] .
Can a model maintain accuracy across old and new classes while making clear which visual attributes support each decision?
blocks.zh:
在许多视觉识别应用中,新类别的数据将在初始模型培训完毕后到达。
班级递增学习(CIL)通过对连续几期班级进行模式培训来解决这一背景问题,同时要求它区分迄今所看到的所有班级[23,11].
当存储或隐私限制使模型无法保留早期的训练图像[29,13]时,无实例设置(EFCIL)特别受关注.
为了保持对之前各类的预测准确,现有方法在微调[27,28]或将分类器更新于一组固定特征[13,2]时,会限制视觉表现的变化.
然而,模型是如何得出这些预测的,受到的关注较少[16、20、5]。
一个模型能否保持新旧类的准确性,同时明确哪些视觉属性支持每个决定?

blocks.en:
Concept bottleneck models (CBMs) offer a promising approach to interpretable CIL by basing class predictions on recognizable visual attributes [ 7 , 6 ] .
A CBM trained with supervision from a pretrained vision-language model (VLM) predicts which concepts are present in an image and uses those predictions to score each candidate class [ 14 , 12 ] .
In continual learning, CBMs must balance stability and plasticity as new concepts are introduced.
To preserve old concepts, existing methods typically regularize concept responses [ 16 ] or freeze previously learned concept mappings [ 18 ] .
To use new concepts when recognizing earlier classes, other methods generate synthetic features for those classes and use the resulting concept scores to update the classifier [ 5 , 20 ] .
However, by focusing on how classifier uses new concepts, these methods typically overlook earlier images as a source of supervision for learning those concepts. Earlier training images may show the relevant attributes long before the concepts are introduced.
For example, if webbed feet is introduced only when geese arrive, the duck images that could have helped the model learn to recognize this attribute have already been discarded.
Across the three datasets in Fig. 1 (left), images from earlier classes account for an average of 35.7% of the VLM matches for concepts introduced later.
On CUB (right), CI-CBM [ 5 ] recovers 23.0% of the VLM’s old-image matches, while RetroCBM and full rehearsal each recover 48.5%.
These findings suggest that learning new concepts from earlier images could improve old-class recognition and support explanations for all seen classes in a shared, expanding concept space.
blocks.zh:
概念瓶颈模型通过将可识别的视觉属性作为类预测的基础,为可解释的CIL提供了一个很有希望的办法[7、6]。
接受过预先训练的视觉语言模型(VLM)监督培训的建立信任措施预测图像中有哪些概念,并利用这些预测来评分每个考生[14、12]。
在不断学习的过程中,随着新概念的引入,建立信任措施必须平衡稳定性和可塑性。
为了保留旧的概念,现有方法通常使概念反应规范化[16]或冻结以前学到的概念绘图[18].
为了在识别早期的类时使用新概念,其他方法为这些类产生合成特征,并利用由此产生的概念分数更新分类器[5,20].
然而,通过注重分类者如何使用新概念,这些方法通常忽略了早期的图像作为学习这些概念的监督来源. 早期的训练图像可能早在提出概念之前就显示出相关的属性.
例如,如果只有在鹅到达时才引入网床脚,那么本来可以帮助模型学习识别这个属性的鸭子图像就已经被丢弃了.
在图1(左)的三个数据集中,来自先前各类的图像平均占后来引入的概念的VLM匹配率的35.7%。
在CUB(右)上,CI-CBM[5]恢复了23.0%的VLM的老图像匹配,而RetroCBM和全排练则各恢复48.5%。
这些调查结果表明,从早先的图像中学习新的概念,可以提高旧阶级的认识,支持在共同的、不断扩大的概念空间中对所有所见阶层的解释。

blocks.en:
However, applying new concepts to previously learned classes poses three key challenges.
First, as new classes introduce new concepts, the model can no longer examine earlier training images to determine whether and to what extent they exhibit those concepts.
Second, even after the model has learned a new concept, it must determine how to use it alongside existing concepts when recognizing earlier classes.
For example, webbed feet can help distinguish ducks from birds that lack them, but offer little help in telling ducks and geese apart.
Third, it is difficult to assess how much a decision relies on errors in concept prediction.
If equally visible webbed feet consistently receive lower scores in ducks than in geese, the model may use that bias to separate them.
blocks.zh:
然而,将新概念应用到以前学习的班级中,提出了三大挑战。
首先,随着新课程引入新概念,该模式不能再审查早期的培训图像,以确定它们是否以及在何种程度上展现了这些概念。
第二,即使在模型学到了一个新概念之后,它也必须确定如何在承认较早的类别时与现有概念并用。
例如,网床脚可以帮助区分鸭子和缺乏它们的鸟类,但很少帮助告诉鸭子和鹅分开.
第三,很难评估决定在多大程度上依赖于概念预测的错误。
如果同样可见的网床脚在鸭子中得到的分数始终低于鹅,模型可能利用这种偏差将它们分开.

blocks.en: We introduce RetroCBM, a label-free concept bottleneck model for EFCIL with a shared, expanding concept vocabulary. Our central observation is that a small set of statistics collected from earlier images can provide supervision for concepts named later. Before discarding the images, RetroCBM records how their visual features relate to the image embeddings that the VLM uses to score concept descriptions. When a new description arrives, retroactive concept regression uses these statistics to recover the same concept predictor as class-balanced ridge regression on all images seen so far. We then propose moment reprojection to recover the classification loss in the updated concept space, allowing each earlier class to learn which new concepts help distinguish it from other classes. To limit the effect of concept prediction errors, our graph-weighted margin distortion penalty discourages changes in the score margin between similar classes when predicted concept scores replace the VLM scores. Our key contributions are as follows. • We find that images from earlier classes often contain attributes named only later. On CUB, human annotations show that supervision from these images improves recognition of newly named color attributes. • We introduce RetroCBM, a label-free CBM that uses stored statistics to recover full-history ridge predictors for new concepts and refit old-class classifiers in the expanded concept space. • Across six datasets, RetroCBM achieves the highest average incremental accuracy (AIA) in all 16 settings, with an 18.1% relative gain in mean AIA over CI-CBM, the strongest exemplar-free interpretable method.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Exemplar-Free Class-Incremental Learning
blocks.zh: 2.1 课外无课-增量学习

blocks.en:
Class-incremental learning (CIL) aims to learn new classes sequentially while recognizing all seen classes without task identifiers at test time.
Exemplar-free CIL further prohibits retaining historical training examples.
Its central challenge is to acquire new knowledge while preserving old-class discrimination without revisiting previous data.
Existing approaches address this challenge through complementary strategies.
Distillation and regularization constrain changes to learned representations [ 27 , 28 ] , while selective parameter adaptation and architectural expansion accommodate new knowledge with reduced interference [ 23 , 26 , 24 ] .
Some methods summarize earlier classes in feature space [ 13 , 2 ] . ACIL [ 29 ] , RanPAC [ 11 ] , and DPCR [ 4 ] use historical feature statistics to update class predictors, with DPCR also accounting for feature drift.
By contrast, RetroCBM uses statistics from earlier images to supervise concepts named only after those images have been discarded.
blocks.zh:
班级递增学习(CIL)旨在依次学习新课,同时在测试时识别所有没有任务标识的所见课.
无实例的CIL进一步禁止保留历史训练实例.
其中心挑战是获得新知识,同时保留旧阶级的歧视,而不重温以前的数据。
现有办法通过互补战略来应对这一挑战。
稀释和规范化限制了对学到的表述的改变[27、28],而选择性的参数调整和建筑扩展则适应了新的知识,减少了干扰[23、26、24]。
一些方法总结了在特征空间中早期的类 [13, 2]. ACIL [29], RanPAC [11], 和 DPCR [4] 使用历史特征统计来更新类预测器, DPCR 也计算了特征漂移.
相比之下,RetroCBM使用早期图像的统计数据来监督仅在这些图像被丢弃后命名的概念.

blocks.en: 2.2 Concept Bottleneck Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 概念波特伦克模型

blocks.en:
Concept bottleneck models [ 7 ] use human-interpretable concepts as an intermediate representation, enabling users to understand model decisions and intervene on concept predictions.
Post-hoc CBMs [ 21 ] construct concept predictors from pre-trained representations, while LF-CBM [ 12 ] and LaBo [ 19 ] use foundation models to reduce dependence on concept annotations.
In continual learning, the concept vocabulary expands as new classes arrive.
ICICLE [ 16 ] and IN2 [ 18 ] preserve existing concepts by regularizing visual prototypes and freezing existing concept mappings, respectively.
CONCIL [ 9 ] recursively updates its concept and class predictors from each phase’s labels and representations.
CLG-CBM [ 20 ] and CI-CBM [ 5 ] use pseudo-features to represent earlier classes. CI-CBM projects these pseudo-features through the current concept layer to learn how new concepts contribute to old-class predictions. As Tab. 1 shows, a new concept can contribute to old-class predictions even when its predictor was learned without supervision from earlier classes.
By contrast, RetroCBM learns these weights by reprojecting stored visual statistics into the expanded concept space.
For a fixed current concept layer, this recovers the same class-balanced squared loss that would be obtained by evaluating the classifier on all images seen so far.
blocks.zh:
概念瓶颈模型 [7] 使用人类解释的概念作为中间代表,使用户能够理解模型决定,干预概念预测.
后热CM[21]通过预先训练的表示法构建概念预测器,而LF-CBM[12]和LaBo[19]则使用基础模型以减少对概念说明的依赖.
在不断学习中,概念词汇随着新课的到来而扩展.
ICICLE [16]和IN2 [18]分别通过规范视觉原型和冻结现有概念映射来维护现有概念.
CONCIL [9] 从每个阶段的标签和表示方式不断更新其概念和类预测器.
CLG-CBM [20]和CI-CBM [5] 使用伪版代表早期的类. CI-CBM通过目前的概念层对这些伪地貌进行预测,以学习新概念如何有助于旧式的预测. 作为 Tab. 1 显示,一个新的概念可以促进旧类的预测,即使它的预测器是在没有早期班级监督的情况下学习的.
相比之下,RetroCBM通过将存储的视觉统计数据重新投射到扩展的概念空间来学习这些权重.
对于一个固定的电流概念层,这回收了通过对迄今看到的所有图像进行分类器评价而获得的同样类平衡平方损失。

blocks.en:
Learning objectives. At each phase, learning must balance two objectives: (1) Stability: keep predictions for existing concepts aligned with their VLM reference scores and continue to recognize earlier classes among all seen classes. (2) Plasticity: learn new concepts and classes and use the new concepts to recognize earlier classes.
Once earlier images have been discarded, the learner can no longer score them against new concept descriptions or pass them through the updated concept layer to update the classifier.
Concept prediction errors can also alter the score margin between two classes. To tackle these challenges, we thus introduce retroactive concept regression, moment reprojection, and a graph-weighted margin distortion penalty in next section.

blocks.en:
Suppose the concept webbed feet is introduced with geese after the training images of ducks have been discarded.
As shown in Fig. 2 , RetroCBM uses stored feature statistics to fit concept predictors to VLM reference scores across all seen classes, so the earlier images of ducks still contribute to learning the new concept ( Sec. 4.1 ).
With the concept layer fixed, we reproject the stored visual statistics to update the classifier in the expanded concept space, allowing it to learn how much webbed feet should contribute to the score for ducks ( Sec. 4.2 ).
During this update, we penalize shifts in the margins between neighboring classes when predicted concept scores replace the VLM reference scores ( Sec. 4.3 ).

blocks.en: In this section, we first describe the experimental setup and compare our RetroCBM with baselines on six datasets. We then report ablation studies, sensitivity to regularization parameters, and inference storage costs. Finally, we conduct a qualitative case study to illustrate its interpretability.

blocks.en: We evaluate RetroCBM on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 [ 8 ] , CUB [ 17 ] , Aircraft [ 10 ] , Places365 [ 25 ] , and ImageNet [ 15 ] . We follow the official data splits for training and testing. Each phase introduces new classes and their associated concepts from a vocabulary shared with CI-CBM. We reuse existing concept lists and supplement them as needed with candidates generated from class names by GPT-5 and filtered with CLIP [ 14 ] . After each phase, we discard its training images and per-image features. Table 2 lists the phase counts for datasets.

blocks.en: 5.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
Table 2 reports average incremental accuracy (AIA) across six datasets. We make three observations.
(1) Averaged across all 16 settings, RetroCBM achieves an 18.1% relative gain in AIA over CI-CBM, the strongest exemplar-free baseline in every setting. This result shows that RetroCBM can use stored feature statistics to update its expanding concept bottleneck without revisiting earlier images and still achieve higher average accuracy than CI-CBM.
(2) RetroCBM outperforms CI-CBM at every phase count on both CUB and Aircraft, with the largest gain of 23.1 percentage points on Aircraft at 20 phases. These results show that the expanding concept bottleneck remains effective for fine-grained distinctions among bird species and aircraft models.
(3) On four of the five datasets tested at multiple phase counts, the AIA gap in favor of RetroCBM widens as the same classes are split across more phases. With fewer new classes per phase, supervision from earlier classes becomes more important for learning shared concepts. RetroCBM incorporates this supervision through stored statistics and updates old-class weights, which may explain its larger gains in these settings.

(1) 在所有16个设置中,RETroCBM在AIA中比CI-CBM实现18.1%的相对收益,这是每个设置中最强的无实例基线. 这个结果表明RetroCBM可以使用存储的特征统计来更新其扩展的概念瓶颈而不重温先前的图像,并且仍然比CI-CBM实现更高的平均精度.
(2) 反弹道导弹在CUB和飞机的每个阶段都超过了CI-CBM,在20个阶段飞机的最大收益为23.1个百分点。 这些结果表明,不断扩大的概念瓶颈对于鸟类物种和飞机模型之间的细微区别仍然有效。
(3) 在多阶段计数测试的5个数据集中,4个数据集有利于RetroCBM的AIA差距扩大,因为相同的类别被分成更多的阶段。 由于每个阶段的新课程较少,对学习共同概念来说,早期课程的监督变得更加重要。 RetroCBM通过存储的统计数据纳入这种监督,并更新旧级的权重,这可以解释它在这些环境下的较大收益.

blocks.en: 5.3 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 5.3 阅读研究

blocks.en:
Figure 3 shows how historical statistics help learn new concepts and how old-class classifiers use them. We make three observations.
(1) Historical statistics improve recognition of late-arriving concepts. When a new concept arrives, we fit its predictor either on current-phase images alone or with additional statistics from earlier classes.
Using these statistics improves recall of the VLM’s top-ranked old images by 3.02 to 11.72 percentage points across four datasets ( Fig. 3 (a)).
We also evaluate predictions against human attribute labels on CUB ( Fig. 3 (b)).
Attribute mAP rises from 18.47% to 21.28%, and within-species AUROC rises from 48.98% to 53.22%, indicating better attribute recognition even among birds of the same species.
(2) Refitting old-class classifiers improves old-class accuracy. With the concept predictor fixed, we either freeze the old-class weights or refit them in the expanded concept space through moment reprojection ( Fig. 3 (c)).
Refitting improves mean old-class accuracy in all nine settings on CUB, Aircraft, and CIFAR-100, with gains of 8.05 to 18.53 percentage points.
(3) Late-arriving concepts provide an additional gain beyond refitting. We refit the old-class classifiers in both conditions, allowing each class to use either the concepts available at its arrival or all concepts seen so far ( Fig. 3 (d)).
Giving old classes access to later concepts adds 7.39 percentage points to old-class accuracy on CUB and 6.60 points on Aircraft in the ten-phase setting.

(1) 历史统计增进了对迟到概念的认识。 当一个新概念出现时,我们要么将其预测器单独放在当前阶段的图像上,要么与先前各类的额外统计数据相匹配。
利用这些统计数据,可以更好地回顾VLM在4个数据集中排名最高的老图像,从3.02到11.72个百分点(图3(a))。
我们还对照CUB上的人类属性标签来评价预测(图3(b))。
属性mAP从18.47%上升到21.28%,物种内的AUROC从48.98%上升到53.22%,这表明即使在同一物种的鸟类中,属性识别也更好.
(2)对老一流的分类人员进行反思,提高老一流的准确性. 随着概念预测器的固定,我们要么冻结旧级的重量,要么通过瞬间再预测在扩大的概念空间中重新调整重量(图3(c))。
在CUB、Aircraft和CIFAR-100上的所有9个设置中,参考改进均意味着旧的准确度,提高8.05至18.53个百分点。
(3) 迟到的概念提供了超出重新适应的额外好处。 我们在两个条件中都重新采用旧的分类法,使每个等级都能够使用到来时已有的概念或迄今看到的所有概念(图3(d))。
向老班级提供后期概念,使CUB的旧班级精确度增加了7.39个百分点,在10阶段设置时,飞机的精确度增加了6.60个百分点。

blocks.en: Figure 4 shows how the concept regression coefficient λ s \lambda_{s} and the graph penalty η \eta affect concept predictions and classification accuracy. On CUB and Aircraft, old-image recall is more sensitive to λ s \lambda_{s} than validation macro AIA (top row). Recall peaks near half the baseline value of λ s \lambda_{s} and declines as regularization grows stronger, while recall on CIFAR-100 remains nearly constant over the same range. Thus, even when classification accuracy changes little, the choice of λ s \lambda_{s} can affect how well a new concept retrieves earlier-class images that the VLM ranks highly. The graph penalty reduces how often neighboring classes exchange rank when the classifier uses predicted concept scores in place of VLM scores (bottom row). Across all four datasets, a weak penalty ( η = 0.01 \eta=0.01 ) reduces these ranking flips while keeping AIA close to its value without penalty. A stronger penalty reduces flips further at a cost to accuracy. On CUB, increasing η \eta from 0 0 to 1 1 roughly halves the flip rate but lowers AIA by about 12 percentage points.

blocks.en: To test what the stored statistics preserve, we compare RetroCBM with an offline reference that uses individual features from all training images. We perform this comparison after the final phase of the ten-phase experiments on CUB, CIFAR-100, and Aircraft ( Tab. 3 ). The two approaches yield numerically identical concept weights and scores on the same test images. For the classifier, they also give the same objective value and subgradient at fixed weights, up to numerical precision. The largest discrepancy is 1.36 × 10 − 12 1.36\times 10^{-12} . These results confirm that the stored statistics preserve the contribution of earlier images both to learning late-arriving concepts and to evaluating the classifier objective in concept space.
blocks.zh: 为了测试所储存的统计数据所保存的内容,我们比较了RetroCBM与使用所有训练图像中的个人特征的离线参考. 在CUB、CIFAR-100和Aircraft(Tab. 3)的十阶段试验最后阶段之后,我们进行了这一比较。 两种方法在同一测试图像上产生数字上相同的概念权重和分数。 对于分类器,它们也会在固定的权重上给出相同的客观值和亚阶,最高的数值精确度. 最大的差异是1.36×10 — 12 1.36\times 10×12}。 这些结果证实,存储的统计数据保留了早期图像对学习晚到概念和评价概念空间中的分类目标的贡献。

blocks.en: On CUB with ten phases, RetroCBM achieves the highest AIA while storing about 2 MiB of learned parameters for inference ( Fig. 6 , left). ICICLE, IN2, and CONCIL all use more storage and achieve lower AIA. Even CONCIL, the most accurate of these three, uses over 100 times as much storage as RetroCBM. CI-CBM matches the storage cost of RetroCBM but trails it by 5.2 percentage points in AIA. At this same storage cost, RetroCBM also more than doubles old-image recall : it retrieves 48.52% of the old-class images that the VLM ranks highest for late-arriving concepts, compared with 23.03% for CI-CBM ( Fig. 6 , right).
blocks.zh: 在具有十个阶段的CUB上,RetroCBM实现了最高的AIA,同时存储了大约2个学习到的参数用于推论(图6,左). ICICLE,IN2,以及CONCIL都使用更多的存储并实现较低的AIA. 甚至CONCIL,这三种中最准确的,也使用了比RetroCBM多100倍的存储量. CI-CBM与RetroCBM的存储成本相匹配,但在AIA中追踪了5.2个百分点. 以同样的存储成本,RetroCBM还双倍于旧形象回忆:它检索了VLM在晚到概念上最高的48.52%的旧阶级图像,而CI-CBM(图6,右)则占23.03%.

Figure 5 traces how the concept yellow crown , introduced in phase four, affects the predictions for two CUB images. In the top image, the Prothonotary Warbler has a visibly yellow crown, and RetroCBM assigns the concept a response of + 2.97 +2.97 . This response adds 0.63 0.63 to the Prothonotary Warbler score and subtracts 1.19 1.19 from the Hooded Warbler score. The late-arriving concept thus contributes 1.82 1.82 points to the margin in favor of the correctly predicted Prothonotary Warbler.
In the bottom image, RetroCBM assigns an even higher yellow crown response ( + 3.13 +3.13 ) to a Hooded Warbler. With the same classifier weights, this response raises the Prothonotary Warbler score by 0.67 0.67 and lowers the Hooded Warbler score by 1.25 1.25 . The model again predicts Prothonotary Warbler. In this case, the same late-arriving concept favors the incorrect class by 1.92 1.92 points.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we proposed RetroCBM, a concept bottleneck model for exemplar-free class-incremental learning. RetroCBM uses stored feature statistics to learn newly introduced concepts from earlier classes after their training images have been discarded. By reprojecting the same statistics into the expanded concept space, the classifier learns how to combine new and existing concepts for each earlier class. A graph-weighted penalty limits the influence of concept prediction errors on the score margins between similar classes. Across six datasets, RetroCBM outperforms state-of-the-art interpretable methods in all 16 settings, with an 18.1% relative gain in mean AIA over the strongest exemplar-free baseline. Our CUB case study shows how the late-arriving concept yellow crown supports a correct prediction for one bird and reinforces a misclassification for another.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出了RetroCBM,这是无课-增量学习的概念瓶颈模型. RetroCBM使用存储的特征统计,在培训图像被丢弃后从早期班级学习新引入的概念. 通过将同样的统计重新投射到扩展的概念空间中,分类者学会了如何将新概念和现有概念结合到每一个早期的类中. 一个图加权的判罚限制了概念预测错误对类似类间分差的影响. 在六个数据集中,RetroCBM在所有16个环境中都超过了最先进的可解释方法,平均AIA的相对收益超过最强的无实例基线的18.1%。 我们的CUB案例研究显示,晚到的概念黄冠如何支持对一只鸟的正确预测,并强化对另一只鸟的错分类.
